findings.F1: Volume predicts the 3-day move better than the tested 30-day return does. The log of a coin's last-day mean volume over its last-ten-day mean volume has a pooled slope on the 18-bar excess return of +0.0077 (t 3.81, 5148 non-overlapping cases), and the 3-day versus 20-day version has slope +0.0104 (t 4.00, 4716 cases). Excess return rises from -0.55 % in the lowest per-coin volume quintile to +0.79 % in the highest (t 2.64).
findings.F2: The volume effect holds broadly and is stronger over one day and after a rising day.
findings.F3: The coin's 7-day return, divided by its 30-day bar volatility, carries the tested idea's effect.
findings.F4: The 30-day return alone is weak and unstable.
findings.F5: The 4h bar that opens at 20:00 UTC rises more than the coin's average bar.
findings.F6: The book is mostly the coins' own large up-days.
findings.F7: A short run of bars in one direction does not predict the 3-day move. The signed count of consecutive same-direction bars has a rank-slope t of only 0.55, and the 1-day vol-scaled return a t of -1.58. The brief's run-and-exhaustion structure does not show in the next 3 days.

ideas.idea: The higher a coin's volume over its last day relative to its average volume over the last ten days, the more the coin rises over the next day beyond its normal drift.
ideas.consequence: A trader leans long a coin in proportion to how far its recent volume runs above its own norm, and refuses longs while volume runs well below it.
ideas.name: volume surge predicts rise

ideas.idea: After a day on which the coin rose, the higher its volume over that day relative to its ten-day average volume, the more it keeps rising over the next three days beyond its normal drift.
ideas.consequence: A trader adds to a long after a rising day in proportion to the volume behind it, and refuses to chase a rising day made on thin volume.
ideas.name: rising day on volume continues

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's 7-day return, measured in units of its own 30-day volatility, the more it rises over the next three days beyond its normal drift.
ideas.consequence: A trader sizes a long by the coin's volatility-scaled one-week rise rather than by its raw 30-day return.
ideas.name: vol-scaled weekly trend continuation
